derivation: amendment A12: an absolute URL needs scheme plus authority and the scheme need not be http(s); http manifest urls and http alternates are clean.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="http://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="http://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="http://beta.example/b">
</head><body></body></html>
files.b.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="http://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="http://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="http://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: clean-http-scheme
